messages.text: Hi, I need pricing information for your AI Chatbot solution.
Hello! Our AI Chatbot plans start at ₹15,000/month. Would you like a personalized demo for your company?
Yes, please connect me with your sales team.
Great! I have notified our sales executive. They will reach out to you shortly.
Can your CRM integrate with WhatsApp for automated lead follow-ups?
Yes! Our CRM includes built-in WhatsApp Automation for instant lead alerts, automated follow-ups, and broadcast campaigns.
That sounds perfect. How soon can we set this up?
Setup usually takes less than 48 hours. Let me schedule a quick discovery call for you.
Looking for custom website development and AI automation.
We offer full-stack website development integrated with custom AI workflows. May I have your email address?
Sure, it is contact@company.in
Thank you! Our technical lead will email you our portfolio and initial proposal.
